brand-script.purpose: Caveat is reserved for the word Malu.

body.purpose: Manrope keeps catalog information easy to scan.

shadows.name: nav-float
shadows.purpose: Lift the opaque navigation capsule above photography.

shadows.name: trust-panel
shadows.purpose: Separate factual trust signals from the destination image.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Provide ambient feedback when a catalog card is hovered.

components.name: Primary WhatsApp Button
components.description: The only maximum-weight action in the viewport.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; border-radius:9999px; background:#8ddff0; color:#063f39; padding:0 24px; font:800 14px Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#b3edf8; }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: An opaque near-white capsule over the hero photograph.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height:64px; border-radius:9999px; background:#f7fffe; color:#063f39; padding:0 20px; box-shadow:0 16px 50px rgba(2,39,36,.18); }

narrative.overview: Destination energy meets a bright, direct interface. Ocean cyan, deep jungle green, one solar accent, decisive photography, and opaque information surfaces create a lively Costa Rican identity.

rules.name: The One Beacon Rule
rules.body: Only WhatsApp receives the cyan maximum-weight fill in a viewport.

rules.name: The Signature Word Rule
rules.body: Caveat is reserved for Malu in the hero and brand mark.

rules.name: The Grounded Surface Rule
rules.body: Shadows indicate a surface crossing photography or reacting to interaction.

dos: Do keep ocean cyan and jungle green visible in key interactions.
Do use verified facts in proof and trust patterns.
Do keep both hero actions on one row with different visual weight.
donts: Don't invent ratings, reviews, or social profiles.
Don't add another filled action beside WhatsApp.
Don't introduce custom CSS or inconsistent top-level widths.
